QuestInfo.name: Repair Record for the Sheriff
QuestInfo.0: The sheriff robot #b#p3005030##k needs to be fixed. Listen to #b#p3005001##k to find out how.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p3005001#, #bKelly#k the mechanic is the only one who can fix #p3005030#, but she's no longer in Arcus. Find Kelly's repair records to fix #p3005030#.
QuestInfo.2: While looking for the repair records, you discovered a letter Kelly wrote. Apparently, Kelly left Arcus to fight against the Flora army... Who could #bthey#k be?

0.msg: Didn't you find the repair record? Double check the garage.
